## Critique
- claim-1: The proof is correct and establishes the named block-lemma certificate. In particular, \(\det W=\det(U^{-1})=\pm1\), so the column transformation is unimodular; the residual identity makes every nonselected row an integral combination of selected rows; and the transformed matrix is an identity block with zero rows, yielding exactly \(|D|\) unit Smith entries. The kernel computation for \(\pi\) proves that the original \(B\)-coordinate classes freely generate the quotient. The cases \(D=\varnothing\) and \(B=\varnothing\), including both empty, are handled correctly. This establishes only the requested lemma, not the separate degreewise \((2,2,4,4)\) computational witnesses or any parent theorem.
